The main issues are incomplete execution-state restoration, scoring outside the explicit autocast context, an undefined collapse statistic when `sample_size=1`, and audit status that does not distinguish observed ranking differences. The runner, fault injection, and simulator transport remain optional and are not implemented by this adapter; these checks must remain unavailable when transport is missing. The callback deadline is checked after return and cannot enforce subprocess termination itself.
